ServicesIndex.title: Three services, one person to speak to.
ServicesIndex.intro: To be surrounded as you always have been. For you or for those close to you, the house arranges the presence that suits.

items.title: You write to us.
items.text: Or you ask us to call you back. A few lines are enough, for yourself or for someone close to you.

items.title: We get to know you.
items.text: A conversation, by telephone or in person, to understand the situation, the daily habits and what is expected.

items.title: We introduce you to the right person.
items.text: One or more people, chosen for you. You decide with us; we never choose for you.

items.title: You sign directly with the professional you choose.
items.text: They arrange the hours and the day-to-day follow-up with you.

items.title: We stay close.
items.text: We keep in touch. If something needs adjusting, or someone needs replacing, we see to it.

model.title: The house introduces, the professional signs, the house keeps watch.

items.title: Introduce
items.text: We meet and vet every person before introducing them to you. You choose with us.

items.title: Sign
items.text: The contract is between you and the professional you choose, whether independent or a partner house.

items.title: Keep watch
items.text: We keep in touch. If something is not right, tell us: we adjust, or we introduce someone else.

selection.title: How we choose
paragraphs: We work with independent professionals and partner houses.
Every person we introduce has been met and vetted. We choose them for their skill and for their bearing. We recommend no one we would not trust with our own family.

payment.title: How the house is paid
paragraphs: You pay nothing to the house. You pay the professional you have chosen directly.
The house is paid by them, and we tell you so from our very first conversation.

limits.title: What the house does not do
items: It does not employ the people it introduces to you.
It does not set their hours: the professional arranges them with you.
It does not manage your money.

confidentiality.title: In complete confidence
paragraphs: Everything you entrust to us stays within the house; we pass on to the professional you choose only what is useful to them, with your consent. Each enquiry is read in person, kept in an encrypted vault in the European Union, then erased.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: Discretion is the promise of the house. We collect as little as possible, we encrypt what we keep, we keep nothing longer than necessary, and we pass nothing on without your consent.
Privacy.updated: Last updated: [À DÉFINIR à la mise en ligne]

sections.title: In brief
items: No cookies, no tracking tools, no social networks.
We never ask for medical information.
The content of your enquiries is encrypted as soon as it arrives and kept in a vault hosted in the European Union.
We do not sell, rent or pass on any information; we pass on to the professional you choose only what is useful to them, with your consent.
You may see, correct or have erased what we keep at any time.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your data
paragraphs: The data controller is Maison Triona, based in Wallonia, Belgium. [À CONFIRMER selon la forme juridique]

sections.title: When you write to us
paragraphs: To reply to you, the form asks for:
items: The service you are interested in and, if you wish, who it is for.
The country concerned.
Whether the enquiry is urgent.
Your name, and an email address or a telephone number.
When and in which language you would prefer us to contact you.
A message, if you wish.
How you heard of the house, if you would like to say.
after: This information is used to reply to you and, if you wish, to introduce you to the right person. It is processed on the basis of the steps you take before any agreement (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR). How you heard of the house is used only to know where enquiries come from. [À VALIDER JURIDIQUEMENT]

The service, the country, the urgency, your name, an email address or a telephone number, the language and your consent are needed to reply to you; everything else is optional. [À CONFIRMER avec le formulaire]

There is no need to share any medical details; we will talk about it in person. If your message contains some all the same, ticking the box before sending gives your explicit consent to their processing, for this enquiry only (Article 9(2)(a) GDPR). [À VALIDER JURIDIQUEMENT]
If you choose to meet a professional, we pass on to them, with your consent, your name, your contact details and what is useful to them about your situation. [À VALIDER JURIDIQUEMENT]
If you ask us to call you back, we keep your name, your number, and the language and time you chose. We never leave a voicemail.
If you give an email address, you receive a short confirmation. It repeats nothing of your enquiry.
No decision is made by automated means: every enquiry is read by a person.

sections.title: How your enquiries are protected
items: The content of your enquiry (your name, contact details, preferred time, who it is for and your message) is encrypted as soon as it reaches our server, then stored in a vault hosted in the European Union.
So that we can sort enquiries, a few details remain readable in the vault: the service, the country, the language, the urgency, the source and the dates.

Only two people can read the encrypted content: the founder of the house and the person in charge of the technical upkeep of the site. Every login requires two-factor authentication; every reading, export or deletion is recorded in a log.
The message that tells us a new enquiry has arrived contains nothing of your enquiry: only its date and a link to the vault.

Our technical logs keep nothing you write: only an identifier and the outcome of the submission. As for any website, our host records the address of the pages visited, the date, your IP address and your browser, for one day. [À CONFIRMER à la mise en ligne]

To block abusive submissions, we keep for 24 hours at most a fingerprint of your IP address, computed with a key changed every day, and a fingerprint of the confirmation address (legitimate interest, Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).

sections.title: Our correspondence, afterwards
paragraphs: Once we are in touch, we reply by email or by telephone. Our email correspondence is kept in the house mailbox, hosted by [À DÉFINIR], for as long as we work together, then [À DÉFINIR].

sections.title: What we measure
paragraphs: To know whether the site is useful, we count page views and a few choices, such as the service viewed, always as totals. The tool we use, Plausible, sets no cookies. To count visitors without identifying them, it computes a daily fingerprint from your IP address and your browser, with a key erased every 24 hours; your IP address is not kept, only the country, region and city are derived from it. It is served from our own domain; its data is hosted in Germany.
This measurement rests on our legitimate interest in knowing whether the site serves its purpose (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR). [À VALIDER JURIDIQUEMENT]

sections.title: Cookies and storage in your browser
paragraphs: This site sets no cookies. The language is shown in the address of the page.

During your visit, and only for as long as it lasts, your browser may keep three things: the fact that you closed the language suggestion, the fact that you paused the videos, and the choices already made for your enquiry (service, country, language, time), so that they are not lost from one page or step to the next. Who the enquiry is for, your name, contact details, message and urgency are never kept there. Everything disappears when you close the tab; the choices for your enquiry are also erased when you send it.
As there is nothing to accept, the site shows no cookie banner. [À VALIDER JURIDIQUEMENT]

sections.title: Our technical providers
paragraphs: A few providers keep the site running. Each is bound to the house by a data processing agreement and uses your information only for the service it provides. [À CONFIRMER à la signature des contrats]

sections.title: Outside the European Union
paragraphs: Vercel and Upstash are American companies: even when processed on European servers, data may be accessible from the United States. These transfers rely on the data protection framework between the European Union and the United States, to which both companies have signed up, and on the safeguards set out in their contracts. [À VALIDER JURIDIQUEMENT]

sections.title: How long we keep your information
items: Your enquiry: for as long as we are in touch, then no more than 12 months after our last exchange, whether or not it led anywhere. We may erase it sooner, and you may ask us to. [À VALIDER JURIDIQUEMENT]
Your call-back request: the same length of time.
Backups: an erased enquiry may remain there for 7 days before it disappears; its content stays encrypted.
Our host’s logs: one day. [À CONFIRMER à la mise en ligne]
Protection against abusive submissions: 24 hours at most.
Email sending logs: [À CONFIRMER selon le fournisseur]
The vault access log: [À DÉFINIR]
Our email correspondence: [À DÉFINIR]

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: At any time, you may see the information we hold about you, have it corrected or erased, object to its processing, restrict its use, receive a copy of it in a common format or have it passed to someone else, and withdraw your consent; withdrawing it does not affect what was done before. Write to us at [CONTENT TO BE PROVIDED BY CAT]; we will reply within one month. [À VALIDER JURIDIQUEMENT]
You may also, at any time, lodge a complaint with the data protection authority of your country. Our supervisory authority is the Data Protection Authority in Belgium. [À VALIDER JURIDIQUEMENT]
items: Belgium: Data Protection Authority (APD).
France: Commission nationale de l’informatique et des libertés (CNIL).
Luxembourg: National Commission for Data Protection (CNPD).
Monaco: Personal Data Protection Authority (APDP).
Switzerland: Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).

sections.title: The limits we know of
paragraphs: No system is perfect. Here are the limits we know of, and would rather tell you about:
items: Our host, Vercel, is an American company. Your enquiry passes through its servers in readable form until it is encrypted; we do not store it there. Like any American company, Vercel may be required by American law to hand over data, even data processed in Europe.
An erased enquiry remains in the backups for up to 7 days; its content stays encrypted.
The confirmation is sent to the address typed into the form. If it reaches you although you did not write to us, please ignore it: it contains nothing but an acknowledgement of receipt.

sections.title: If an incident occurs
paragraphs: If an incident affected your information, we would inform the data protection authority within 72 hours of becoming aware of it and, if the risk were high, the people concerned. [À VALIDER JURIDIQUEMENT]

sections.title: If this policy changes
paragraphs: The new version is published on this page, with its date.
